extName.message: Save image as PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or PDF — Imgkeep
extName.description: Store name and extension name. Max 75 characters. Keep 'Imgkeep' and the format names.

extDescription.message: Right-click to save any image as PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or PDF, or get its colour palette. On your device. No personal data.

menuParent.description: Right-click menu entry on images. Since 0.11.0 just the name: it holds saving, copying and the colour palette.

menuLastUsed.description: Top item of the right-click submenu: saves again in the format used last time. $FORMAT$ is PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, PDF or Original format.

menuGif.description: Menu item: save as GIF, keeping animation.

menuOriginal.description: Menu item: save the file unchanged.

menuCopyPng.description: Right-click menu item: copies the image to the clipboard as PNG. Also the Copy window's title and button.

menuPalette.description: Right-click menu item: shows the image's main colours. Also the palette window's button in More options.

menuMoreOptions.description: Right-click menu item: opens the More options window

menuFindImage.description: Right-click menu item on sites that cover their images (Instagram, Pinterest…)

menuNew.description: A right-click menu item that is new in this version, for 30 days after an update. $ITEM$ is the item's own name.

menuRate.description: Right-click menu item shown once, for up to 14 days, after someone has used Imgkeep for a while. Opens the rating ask.

askErrBlocked.message: The site didn't hand over this image, even with access allowed. The server may be down, or it only serves the image inside its own pages.

askErrHttp.message: The site answered with an error instead of the image.

askErrDecode.message: Your browser couldn't read this file as an image.

askErrUnsupported.message: This browser version can't create this format. Try PNG instead.

askErrBlob.message: This image only exists inside the page (a blob: link), so Imgkeep can't save it yet. A screenshot works.

askErrTooLarge.message: This image is too large to convert in the browser.

askErrTimeout.message: Converting this image took too long, so Imgkeep stopped. Try PNG, or a shorter or smaller animation.

askErrDownload.message: Your browser couldn't start the download.

askErrWrite.message: Imgkeep couldn't write the file to your folder.

askErrExpired.message: This save has expired. Right-click the image and try again.

askErrUnknown.message: Something went wrong while saving this image.

detailGifPixels.message: $W$×$H$ pixels × $COUNT$ frames is more than a GIF can hold here.

detailTooManyFiles.message: Too many files with this name.

askSavedTo.description: Status after saving into a folder.

askRetry.description: Button: try the same save or copy again

askOpenImage.description: Button: opens the image's web address in a new tab

askHostBody.message: $HOST$ blocks other sites from reading its images, so Imgkeep can't convert this one yet.

askHostNote.message: Access is for this one site only, to fetch images you pick. You can remove it any time in Options.

askNotAllowed.message: Access wasn't allowed. Nothing was saved.

askReconnectTitle.description: Window title. Use your language's quotation marks.

askReconnectBody.message: Your browser needs your OK to save into this folder again.

askChooseBody.message: Pick the folder where Imgkeep should save your images.

askEveryVisit.message: When your browser asks, choose $OPTION$ so it won't ask again.

askEveryVisitOption.description: The browser's permission option that lasts. Describe it if the exact wording in your language is unknown.

askFolderDenied.message: Your browser didn't allow access to the folder. Nothing was saved.

askNoFolder.message: No folder chosen. Nothing was saved.

optPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the options page

optSaved.description: Brief confirmation after a setting changes

optSaveMode.description: Hidden label for the three choices

optModeDownloadsHint.message: Saves to your browser's download folder. No questions asked.

optModeFolderHint.message: Writes straight into your folder. Your browser may ask you to reconnect after a restart.

optModeAskHint.message: Shows the browser's Save As dialog for each image.

optSubfolderHint.message: Optional. Use / for nested folders. Same tokens as file names.

optTokensHint.message: Tokens: {name} original name, {host} site, {date}, {time}, {w} and {h} size in pixels. Existing files are never overwritten.

optPreviewLabel.message: Preview for summer-banner from shop.example.com, 1600×900, as PNG:

optJpgBackgroundHint.message: JPG has no transparency, so see-through areas get this colour.

optMaxWidth.description: Label of the maximum width setting (Options and More options)

optMaxWidthPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the empty maximum width field

optMaxWidthHint.message: Optional, in pixels. Wider images are scaled down to fit, keeping their shape; smaller ones are never enlarged. Original format is always saved as it is.
optMaxWidthHint.description: Hint under the maximum width setting

optSitesEmpty.message: None yet. Imgkeep asks only when a site blocks an image you want to convert.

optFindHint.message: On sites like Instagram and Pinterest, right-click and choose Imgkeep: Find image here. Imgkeep only looks at a page when you ask it to find an image there, just that page, just then. It never changes a page.
optFindHint.description: How it works, and the promise (wording B)

optCountsTitle.description: Options section heading: the anonymous daily summary

optCountsHint.message: Once a day, Imgkeep sends a summary like "12 saves as JPG, 1 failed" to PostHog, an open-source analytics service hosted in the EU, so we know which features to improve and which saves fail. Never images, page addresses, file names or anything that identifies you.
optCountsHint.description: What the summary is, where it goes, and what is never in it

optCountsShow.description: Expandable: shows the counts exactly as stored and sent

optCountsLast.description: Label above the last summary sent

optCountsNone.description: Shown when there are no counts yet

optCountsOff.message: Off. Nothing is counted or sent.
optCountsOff.description: Shown instead of today's counts when the summary is turned off

optRemoveAccess.description: Accessible label for the Remove button

optProBody.message: Presets for the sizes and formats you use most, file-size targets like "under 200 KB", rules that send each site's images to the right folder, and a log of where every image came from.

optProFree.message: Everything you use today stays free.

optTrustTitle.message: What Imgkeep can and can't do

optOptionalPermissions.message: Only if you turn on Find images:
optOptionalPermissions.description: Label above the two optional permissions

optTrust1.message: Images are converted on your computer and never uploaded. The only other thing Imgkeep sends is the anonymous daily summary above, which you can turn off.

optTrust2.message: No ads and no welcome tabs. Small windows open only when you ask for one or a save needs your OK. Imgkeep asks for a rating once, after you've used it for a while.

optTrust4.message: Imgkeep only looks at a page when you ask it to find an image there, just that page, just then. It never changes a page.

optWhatsNew.description: Options link to the What's new page on imgkeep.app

copyDone.message: Copied as PNG. Paste it anywhere.

copyFailedNote.message: Your clipboard wasn't changed. Try again, or save the image as a PNG file instead.
copyFailedNote.description: Text when the clipboard refused the image

copySavePng.description: Button: save the image as a PNG file instead of copying

copyAllowAndCopy.description: Button: allow access to the site, then copy

editUpdating.description: Shown while the preview is redone after a change

editPreviewAlt.description: Alt text of the preview image

editOriginal.description: Label before the original image's size

editResult.description: Label before the result's size, format and file size

editPngHint.message: PNG keeps every pixel. For a smaller file, lower the maximum width or choose JPG or WebP.
editPngHint.description: Hint under the format choice when PNG is chosen

editIcoHint.message: An icon file with the image at 16, 32 and 48 px, plus 256 px when it's big enough. Images that aren't square get transparent edges.

editBmpHint.message: A plain bitmap that every app opens. Files are large, and transparent areas get the background colour.

editAvifHint.message: Often half the size of a JPG that looks the same. Modern browsers and most current apps open it; some older apps don't.

editMaxWidthHint.message: In pixels. Keeps the shape, never enlarges.
editMaxWidthHint.description: Hint under the maximum width field

editBackground.description: Label of the JPG background colour

editFileName.description: Label of the file name field

editAllow.description: Button: allow access to the site the image comes from

editNeedsOk.message: This save needs your OK: see the Imgkeep window that just opened.
editNeedsOk.description: Status when the save opened the small ask window

reviewTitle.description: Heading of the one rating ask

reviewBody.message: A rating in the store helps other people find it. It takes a few seconds, and we'll only ask this once.
reviewBody.description: Text of the one rating ask

reviewRate.description: Button and Options link: opens the store's review page

reviewNo.description: Button: decline the rating ask (it won't be asked again)

reviewOk.message: Got it. We won't ask again.

findEnableTitle.description: Heading when Find image is not turned on yet

findEnableBody.message: Some sites, like Instagram and Pinterest, cover their images with another layer, so a right-click can't reach them. Imgkeep can find the image under that layer for you.

findPromise.message: Imgkeep only looks at a page when you ask it to find an image there, just that page, just then. It never changes a page.
findPromise.description: The promise (wording B), shown before turning on

findDenied.message: Not turned on. You can turn it on any time in Options.
findDenied.description: Shown when the browser didn't grant it

findOnBody.message: Right-click the image again and choose Imgkeep: Find image here.
findOnBody.description: What to do after turning on

findPickBody.message: Imgkeep couldn't tell which image you meant. Pick one:

findPickOne.description: Accessible name of a picker button. $NUMBER$ is 1, 2, 3…

findNothingTitle.description: Heading when no image was found

findNothingBody.message: Imgkeep couldn't find an image on this part of the page. Right-click right on the photo, or open the photo on its own page and try again.
findNothingBody.description: What to try when no image was found

findErrorTitle.message: Imgkeep couldn't look at this page
findErrorTitle.description: Heading when the page couldn't be looked at

findErrorBody.message: Reload the page, then right-click the image and choose Find image here again.

paletteLoading.description: While the colours are worked out

paletteCount.description: Label of the 5 / 8 / 12 switch: how many colours to show

paletteSwatches.message: The image's main colours, largest first
paletteSwatches.description: Screen-reader label of the list of colours

paletteCopyOne.description: Tooltip and label of one colour. $VALUE$ is e.g. #C8A27A, $SHARE$ e.g. 32%

paletteCopyAll.description: Label before the buttons that copy every colour as code

paletteCodeTailwind.description: Button: a Tailwind colors snippet. Product name, keep it.

paletteCopiedAll.description: Status after copying all colours. $KIND$ is the button's name (CSS variables, Tailwind…)

paletteSaveAs.description: Label before the buttons that save the palette as a file

paletteSavePng.description: Button: a PNG image with one block per colour and its HEX value

paletteSaveGpl.description: Button: a .gpl palette file (GIMP, Inkscape, Krita)

paletteSaveAse.description: Button: an .ase swatch file (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)

paletteSavedFallback.message: Your folder wasn't available, so it went to Downloads: $PATH$
paletteSavedFallback.description: Status: the chosen folder couldn't be used, so the small palette file went to Downloads

paletteEmpty.message: This image is fully transparent, so it has no colours to take.
paletteEmpty.description: The image has no visible pixels

paletteCopyFailed.message: Couldn't copy. Click inside this window, then try again.
paletteCopyFailed.description: The clipboard refused the text (usually the window lost focus)

paletteNote.message: Worked out on your computer. The image and its colours never leave it.
paletteNote.description: Small print at the bottom of the palette window
